# Align log host call to JIP-1

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

I've updated the log host call to align with https://github.com/polkadot-fellows/JIPs/blob/main/JIP-1.md This change will be required to run the 072 test vectors.

## Walkthrough

This pull request modifies the logging host call implementation to support version-gated behavior. The changes introduce version-dependent gas cost calculations (10 gas for versions >= 0.7.2, otherwise 0), expand imports to include version and result utilities, and update the execute method to allocate buffers, load and decode messages from memory, and conditionally write results to an output register for newer versions. The method signature is simplified to return `Promise<undefined>` instead of including a possible `PvmExecution`.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

- **Version-dependent logic**: The basicGasCost calculation now depends on `GpVersion.V0_7_2` comparison; requires verification of version constant values and conditional logic correctness
- **Register write path**: The conditional write to `IN_OUT_REG` with `HostCallResult.WHAT` is new; needs validation that the register index (7) and result constant are correct
- **Return type change**: The signature change from `Promise<undefined | PvmExecution>` to `Promise<undefined>` has implications; verify all call sites handle the new return type correctly
- **Memory operations**: Buffer allocation and memory loading logic should be reviewed for off-by-one errors and bounds checking

## Possibly related PRs

- **PR `#760`**: Modifies logging behavior in the same file (log.ts) with potential overlapping changes to logging formatting and version-dependent paths
- **PR `#606`**: Implements similar IN_OUT_REG and HostCallResult patterns in other host-call implementations (info.ts), providing context for version-gated register writes
- **PR `#390`**: Updates host-call result semantics and output register behavior, affecting the broader HostCallResult framework used in this change
